# beszel_user (Resource)

Manages a Beszel user account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "beszel_user" "example" {
  email    = "alerts@example.com"
  password = var.beszel_user_password
  role     = "user"
  verified = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address, used to sign in.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password. PocketBase never returns this, so it cannot be read back or diffed against drift.

### Optional

- `role` (String) One of user, admin, or readonly. Defaults to user.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether the account is marked verified.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) PocketBase record ID of the user.
- `username` (String) Auto-generated username.
